preconditions.description: Length of p is less than length of t, both within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in t) and all(c.islower() for c in p)
preconditions.description: Both t and p consist of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == len(t) and all(1 <= ai <= len(t) for ai in a) and len(set(a)) == len(a)
preconditions.description: a is a permutation of indices from 1 to len(t).

postconditions.description: The number of letters Nastya can remove is between 0 and the difference in lengths of t and p.
After Nastya removes return_value letters, the remaining letters form the word p.
